Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing Western Washington University to confer honorary doctoral degrees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to honorary doctoral degrees; and amending RCW28B.35.205.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28B.35.205 and 1991 c 58 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In addition to all other powers and duties given to them by law,Central Washington University, Eastern Washington University, andWestern Washington University are hereby authorized to grant any degreethrough the master's degree to any student who has completed a programof study and/or research in those areas which are determined by thefaculty and board of trustees of the college to be appropriate for thegranting of such degree: PROVIDED, That before any degree isauthorized under this section it shall be subject to the review andapproval of the higher education coordinating board. The board of trustees, upon recommendation of the faculty, may alsoconfer honorary bachelor's or master's degrees upon persons other thangraduates of the institution, in recognition of their learning ordevotion to education, literature, art, or science. Western WashingtonUniversity may confer honorary doctoral degrees upon persons other than p. 1 SB 6910graduates of the institution, in recognition of their learning,devotion to education, literature, art, or science. No degree may beconferred in consideration of the payment of money or the donation ofany kind of property.
